title: Race/Gender research pass
findings: All three uploaded race-test saves read as BretonRace and Male in the save header.
All three contain BretonRace compact RefIDs in Player ChangeForm 400014 as a consecutive 3-entry cluster.
All three contain BretonRace compact RefIDs in Live Player ChangeForm 400007 as a consecutive 2-entry cluster.
A test copy patched from BretonRace to KhajiitRace reopened in the editor and detected KhajiitRace in Player 400014 and Live 400007.
Header race text did not change to KhajiitRace when the fixed header string slot was too short; this appears to be display/load-screen metadata, not the only in-game race source.
Sex/gender is currently only confirmed in the save header. No female paired save was available to map the live in-game gender/body flag.
recommendation: Keep race editing labeled experimental and avoid claiming gender changes in-game until a male/female paired diff is mapped.
